it.title: General IT Services
it.summary: Kalesa Group delivers enterprise-grade IT project management, procurement, and lifecycle support across federal agencies and SLED environments. We ensure personnel can perform their duties without being hindered by outdated tools or fragmented systems.

items.title: Project & Program Management
items.description: Enterprise-grade PM supporting mission-critical IT initiatives — from planning through delivery and transition.

items.title: Hardware & Software Procurement
items.description: End-to-end procurement, installation, and commissioning of hardware and software — domestically and internationally.

items.title: IT Modernization & Consulting
items.description: One-time professional IT consulting for modernization, system optimization, and integration across legacy and modern platforms.

items.title: IT Lifecycle Support
items.description: Ongoing support ensuring personnel can perform their duties without being hindered by outdated technology or broken infrastructure.

telecom.title: Telecom Services
telecom.summary: From voice and data to network infrastructure, Kalesa Group manages telecom programs end-to-end — eliminating legacy communication bottlenecks and ensuring secure, uninterrupted connectivity across multi-site government environments.

items.title: Telecom Project & Program Management
items.description: Structured PM for voice, data, and network infrastructure programs — from requirements through deployment and handoff.

items.title: Multi-site Procurement & Installation
items.description: Procurement, installation, and commissioning of telecom hardware and software across multi-site environments, domestically and internationally.

items.title: Telecom Engineering & Consulting
items.description: One-time telecom engineering and consulting for specific modernization, optimization, or integration needs.

items.title: Legacy System Modernization
items.description: Systematic replacement and modernization of legacy telecom systems to eliminate communication bottlenecks and ensure secure, uninterrupted connectivity.

healthcare.title: Healthcare IT Services
healthcare.summary: Kalesa Group brings specialized Healthcare IT expertise to federal health agencies and SLED health programs — supporting the clinical and administrative workflows that enable positive patient outcomes.

items.title: Healthcare IT Project Management
items.description: Structured PM aligned with clinical and administrative workflows — managing complex EHR implementations and health IT deployments.

items.title: EHR Management & Optimization
items.description: Electronic Health Records management, optimization, and interoperability support — ensuring clinical systems work together seamlessly.

items.title: Telemedicine Platform Deployment
items.description: Telemedicine platform deployment, integration, and operational management — expanding care access while maintaining security and compliance.

items.title: Digital Health Support
items.description: Enabling clinicians to focus on care — not on navigating broken systems. Day-to-day digital health support and continuous improvement.
